parsed.explanation: Documented routine police pretext detention, extortion and sexual abuse of gender-nonconforming people, plus unrepealed same-sex criminalisation (up to 14 years) used as police lever, creates state-implicated targeting. Custody risk is evidenced by 2025 prison nonconsensual procedures and unresolved male/female placement. Courts have delivered some remedies (2018 forced-examination ruling, 2024 compensation, 2025/2026 rulings) but no implementing protection statute is recorded, police abuse is documented through 2020-21, and deterrence is unproven. No execution or trans-specific killing rate is documented, placing this above extreme regimes but materially below jurisdictions where remedies reliably restrain police.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Routine police detention on pretexts, remand beyond constitutional period, extortion, rape by security officers; 2025 incarceration involved nonconsensual medical procedures and court-ordered gender determination; police uncertainty over male/female cells.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: 2025 High Court found dignity/privacy violations and directed legislation; 2018 Court of Appeal held forced anal examinations unconstitutional, compensation awarded 2024.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Pretext arrest can lead to identity-based custody, birth-sex placement uncertainty, and medical exposure; court relief has followed but no enacted statute is recorded.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Trans people fear using sex-designated bathrooms for fear of accusation of sexual crimes (2012 report); no visitor facility-access rule documented.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Facility use can trigger public crowd reaction, stigma and public-nuisance accusations.

care_services.exposure: Documented barriers to gender-affirming care; witness declined surgery without reasons at national referral hospital, appeal unsuccessful (2012, dated).
care_services.interaction: Care-seeking may expose trans status, but visitor continuity/emergency care is not documented.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Section 162: up to 14 years for carnal knowledge against order of nature, 21 years aggravated; s165 gross indecency 5 years; 2019 High Court declined to declare unconstitutional; stalled Family Protection Bill would impose death for aggravated homosexuality (not law).
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Appeal scheduled May 2026 with no decision recorded; courts have limited some police practices, but criminalisation remains.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Sodomy statute is secondary for trans visitors, but here it supplies the documented police lever for detention/extortion of gender-nonconforming people.

minors_guardians.exposure: Not documented for travelling minors/guardians; no legal standing for same-sex partnership and Children Act makes homosexual couples ineligible to adopt (resident-facing).

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Documented routine police harassment and extortion in capital and coastal city interviews; societal discrimination described as widespread; one LGBTQ activist killed, perpetrator sentenced to 50 years in Dec 2024. No trans-specific rate or baseline rate documented, so magnitude cannot be stated.
street_violence_police_response.protection: 2024 50-year sentence shows prosecution in that case; community organisations operate in restrictive civic space.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Police are documented perpetrators in other cases, undermining reliance on police as protective response.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: No implementing Transgender Protection Rights Act recorded; gender-marker ruling for residents (May 2026) has no described visitor procedure; border screening, Family Protection Bill status and appeal outcome not documented.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Court remedies have operated in specific cases (forced examinations, association registration 2023, 2025/2026 rulings).
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Judicial relief is episodic and resident-litigation based, not shown to restrain routine police extortion.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar in routine police stops, confiscation/extortion and slow court deference, but this dossier adds documented rape by security officers, remand beyond constitutional period and prison medical abuse, and retains up-to-14-year criminalisation, so lower than 0.35.

Similar in birth-sex custody uncertainty with reported harm and slow remedies, but this case has stronger court interventions (2018/2024, 2025 dignity finding) and a documented 50-year prosecution for killing, so somewhat higher than 0.25.

Higher because there detention is brief administrative holding with legal aid/consular liaison and no credible imprisonment pathway; here pretext detention, extortion, sexual abuse and a 14-year statute make custody and prosecution credible.

parsed.synthesis: Combined regime: criminalisation supplies police lever, checkpoints/street stops and custody are the operative journey stages, and courts provide partial ex-post correction without documented preventive restraint. Facilities and care exposure are secondary and partly dated; entry and minors are undocumented unknowns, not safety. The harshest operative pattern—state-implicated routine detention/extortion with custody abuse risk and no enacted protection—governs the rating.
